ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications
as shown on Map No. 19-H in the area bounded by:

The public alley next north of and parallel to West Touhy Avenue;

a line 223.5 feet east of and parallel to North Oakley Avenue;
West Touhy Avenue;
a line 200.0 feet east of and parallel to North Oakley Avenue;

to those of a C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Address: 2212 West Touhy Avenue
